LLMClientArchitecture.description:
An LLMClient's architecture, as the workbench's Architecture tab draws it.

``tree`` is the tree of the SAM resources that the LLMClient is built from, as the user may see it. It
has no description of its own, which would make the TypeScript generator copy the node's type.

SAMDependencyTreeNode.description:
A resource in a dependency tree: the resource, and, recursively, every resource that it uses.

It is the opposite direction of :class:`SAMDependency`, which lists the resources that depend
on a resource. An LLMClient's tree has its Provider, its plugins, their Connections, and those
Connections' Secrets. See :meth:`smarter.lib.manifest.broker.AbstractBroker.dependency_tree`.

A resource that the user may not read keeps its kind and record locator, so that the tree still
shows that something is there, but not its name, owner or url, or what it uses in turn.

Example:

.. code-block:: json

    {
      "kind": "LLMClient",
      "icon": "artificial-intelligence",
      "name": "stackademy_sql",
      "owner": "Ada Lovelace (ada)",
      "recordLocator": "llmclient-rMTAwMDAxMwx",
      "url": "/workbench/llm-clients/rMTAwMDAxMwx/manifest/",
      "readable": true,
      "children": [
        {
          "kind": "SqlPlugin",
          "icon": "file-sheet",
          "name": "stackademy_sql",
          "owner": "Ada Lovelace (ada)",
          "recordLocator": "pluginmeta-rMTEx",
          "url": "/llm-tools/plugins/rMTEx/",
          "readable": true,
          "children": []
        }
      ]
    }

children.description: children[List]: The resources that this resource uses, each with its own tree. Read only.
children.title: Children

icon.description: icon[String]: The kind's icon in the web console, a Keen Icons name without its ki- prefix, e.g. lock-2 for a Secret. See SAMKinds.icon(). Read only.
icon.title: Icon

kind.description: kind[String]: The SAM kind of the resource, e.g. LLMClient. Read only.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: name[String]: The name of the resource. None if the user may not read it. Read only.
name.title: Name

owner.description: owner[String]: Who owns the resource: its owner's full name and username, e.g. Ada Lovelace (ada), or an Extension's publisher. None if the user may not read it, or if it has no owner. Read only.
owner.title: Owner

readable.description: readable[Boolean]: Whether the user may read the resource. Read only.
readable.title: Readable

recordLocator.description: recordLocator[String]: The resource's record locator, e.g. llmclient-rMTAwMDAxMwx, from which its web console url is derived. None for a resource that has none, e.g. a User. Read only.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

url.description: url[String]: The path of the resource's manifest page in the web console, where its manifest can be edited, derived from its record locator. None if it has no page, or if the user may not read it. Read only.
url.title: Url
